name: glass-price-card
title: Glass Price Card
description: A frosted-glass card rises over a soft neutral backdrop: blur and a thin light border, no neon. The price counts up and settles, then a small badge lands on the corner.
useWhen: A package, a bundle or a class fee with one price and a short description.
An offer that should feel calm and premium rather than loud.
avoidWhen: A sale with an old and a new price: use price-drop.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Detail
variables.description: Short muted line under the name.

variables.label: Price
variables.description: Counts up. A prefix such as Rp and dot thousands are kept.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Small text after the price. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Badge
variables.description: Pill that lands on the card corner. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Shape colour
variables.description: The solid shapes the glass blurs.

variables.label: Glass tint
variables.description: Card tint (shown at the glass opacity).

variables.label: Glass opacity
variables.description: How much of the tint shows over the blur.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: Badge and price: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
